kind: independent scoped anonymous operator-tool review; not UI self-approval, backend release approval or hosted acceptance
independence: Reviewer did not author the root-owned hosted operator tool. This verdict does not approve the separate banner UI authored by this reviewer.

checks.environment: Installed actual headless Chrome/Playwright, isolated context, two owned synthetic loopback-only HTTP servers; escalation authorized only this test.

resolvedFindings.evidence: Pure root and independent probes reject username/password URL credentials, arbitrary queries and fragments. Normal fixed assets remain allowed; origins and methods stay restricted.
The browser context explicitly blocks Service Workers, and attempted WebSockets are closed and counted as failure.

Every admitted routed request uses one fresh independent APIRequestContext with empty storage, stripped cookie/authorization/referer headers, maxRedirects0, maxRetries0 and15000ms timeout.3xx responses are aborted before browser fulfillment. The independently rerun actual loopback test observes sourceCalls2, redirectTargetCalls0 and sourceCredentialRequests0 despite a seeded synthetic browser cookie. Root pure tests verify transport options, nonredirect fulfillment, redirect refusal, safe exceptions and response/context disposal attempts.

sourceChecks.requestCap: 35 admitted routed requests maximum; check/increment occurs synchronously before awaits; each transport has redirects and retries disabled
sourceChecks.freshIdentityBoundary: No persistent browser profile, stored account state, provider sign-in or supplied real credentials; separate empty transport per request avoids browser-jar reinjection
sourceChecks.allowedSurface: Fixed UAT/production selection; fixed read paths plus same-origin Next static assets; no query strings needed by the reviewed application assets
sourceChecks.privacy: Reports contain fixed counters, fixed targets, booleans, timestamps and allowlisted safe error classes; raw request/header/log/error text is not emitted
sourceChecks.activeInactiveObservation: Source waits15s for active,120s for hidden, and requires identical performance.timeOrigin; it never refreshes or writes application state
sourceChecks.reservation: Existing final/active report or reservation refuses a label; final report writes while lock is held; failed publication leaves the occupied reservation path
sourceChecks.cleanup: Browser close is attempted in finally and failure makes the run fail; each response and independent request context has disposal in finally
sourceChecks.failureAccounting: Blocked requests, cap exhaustion, redirects, transport failures,HTTP5xx, WebSockets, page errors or status credential/referrer counters prevent a successful observation

limits: The hosted main function was not invoked. No hosted URLs, cloud APIs, real users, provider credentials or database were contacted.
The full live active-to-inactive120s observation remains an operator action after this review; source inspection is not a claim that it already happened.
Fresh empty transport behavior deliberately makes this an anonymous observer and cannot establish signed-in Google/Claude acceptance.
The request cap is an admitted HTTP request bound, not a byte-volume, CPU or hosted performance guarantee.
Cleanup failure branches are checked through source and pure transport tests; the loopback test proves ordinary actual cleanup, not every operating-system failure.
This is an operator-tool pass only; no formal global backend rating or product feature closure is claimed.
history: Failed rounds1 and2 and their evidence remain unchanged. The reconstructed round1 source retains explicit after-the-fact provenance and matches its independently recorded original hash.
